statement: ∀ x y z w : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → 0 < z → 0 < w → x ≤ y+z+w → y ≤ x+z+w → z ≤ x+y+w → w ≤ x+y+z → let m := min (max x y) (min (max x z) (min (max x w) (min (max y z) (min (max y w) (max z w))))) ; (1/w)*min (x*y/(z*w)) (z*w/(x*y)) ≤ 3/m
proof:
intro x y z w hx hy hz hw hx' hy' hz' hw'
dsimp only
have hxy : 0 < x*y := mul_pos hx hy
have hzw : 0 < z*w := mul_pos hz hw
have hmin := min_le_left (x*y/(z*w)) (z*w/(x*y))
have hmin' := min_le_right (x*y/(z*w)) (z*w/(x*y))
have hone : min (x*y/(z*w)) (z*w/(x*y)) ≤ 1 := by
  by_cases h : x*y ≤ z*w
  · exact hmin.trans ((div_le_one hzw).2 h)
  · exact hmin'.trans ((div_le_one hxy).2 (le_of_not_ge h).le)
have hnonneg : 0 ≤ min (x*y/(z*w)) (z*w/(x*y)) := le_min (by positivity) (by positivity)
rcases le_total x y with hxyO | hyxO <;>
rcases le_total x z with hxzO | hzxO <;>
rcases le_total x w with hxwO | hwxO <;>
rcases le_total y z with hyzO | hzyO <;>
rcases le_total y w with hywO | hwyO <;>
rcases le_total z w with hzwO | hwzO <;>
try omega
all_goals
  simp_all only [max_eq_left, max_eq_right, min_eq_left, min_eq_right]
all_goals
  first
  | (apply (mul_le_mul_left hw).mp; field_simp; nlinarith)
  | (apply (mul_le_mul_left hw).mp; field_simp at hmin hmin' ⊢; nlinarith [mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hx) (le_of_lt hy),mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hz) (le_of_lt hw)])
